description:
An alternative client for the Bitwarden® platform

Keyguard is an alternative client for the Bitwarden® platform, created to provide the best user experience possible.
Highlights:
- a beautiful rich and responsive Material You user interface;
- a powerful and fast search;
- a support for creating & using passkeys - a modern alternative to passwords.
- a watchtower that finds items with Pwned passwords, Vulnerable accounts, Reused passwords, Inactive two factor authentication, Inactive passkeys, Unsecure Websites as well as Duplicate, Incomplete and Expiring items, and other;
- multi-account support 🌠 with secure login and two-factor authentication support;
- add items 🌠 and sends 🌠, modify 🌠, and view your vault offline;
- export individual or organization items, including the attachments;
- beautiful Light/Dark theme;
- a generator with SSH keys, Email forwarders, Custom wordlists support, and many other features;
- a support for placeholders and URL overrides;
- and much more!
🌠 - on Android requires the Premium one-time or subscription license.
Note
Browser extensions themselves are not yet released and are waiting for their appropriate store reviews. Therefore you can not yet use the browser integration right now, but it will gradually appear in the extension stores.
New
- Browser extension: Added Chrome and Firefox browser extensions.
Improvements
- Desktop: Dialogs, settings screens, and vault screens now have better focus navigation and keyboard handling.
- Desktop: The approval request window is now guarded against accidental clicks for the first second.
- Generator: Usage history older than a configurable number of days is now automatically deleted.
- Generator: Wordlists can now be imported in the Diceware format.
- Generator: Words in a wordlist can now be added, edited, and deleted.
- Autofill: URIs can now be blocked from the save requests list.
- UI: Concealed password text fields now show Caps Lock and non-English keyboard layout badges.
- UI: The app now checks whether a newer version is available on GitHub.
- Android: The predictive back animation now includes a Y-axis parallax effect.
Security
- Desktop: HotSpot Attach is now disabled in release builds.
- Windows: Windows Error Reporting data is now limited.
Fixes
- Bitwarden: Fixed server URLs with single-label hostnames not being supported (#1222).
- UI: Fixed Settings and Backup items so they are grouped together correctly.
